items.title: Jasper Taylor Interview, 1959-06-30
items.q: I just simply had my, played over on the Zillophone and Freddie, got the boys together.

ctx.x: When did you first meet him or hear him?

Well, I met Freddie at, well, I was playing at the Owl Theater, and at nights I would go down on the Strobe, we call it, around the Asia Cafe, and you could meet mostly anyone there. That was a hangout, the Chinese restaurant.
